assessment_requirements: exact reviewed image path and SHA-256
corrective guidance for every FIX or ESCALATE
exact Gold Standard reference IDs used for comparison
reviewer identity different from producer identity
semantic_boundary: Deterministic code validates bindings, completeness and hashes. Only an image-capable independent reviewer evaluates aesthetics, iconography, expressions and cultural authenticity from pixels.
pass_rules: A visual-attractiveness PASS cannot override SOURCE_FIDELITY, RELIGIOUS_ICONOGRAPHY or CULTURAL_AUTHENTICITY failure.
Source accuracy alone does not satisfy NARRATIVE_SPECIFICITY, EMOTIONAL_EXPRESSIVENESS, VISUAL_REFERENCE_ALIGNMENT or PAGE_DESIGN_COMPATIBILITY.
Similarity to a benchmark is not success when benchmark story content has transferred.
